She is dressed in a casual yet stylish outfit consisting of a white strapless crop top, high-waisted beige trousers, and black combat boots. A black belt with a circular buckle is worn around her waist, adding a touch of sophistication to her look. In the left side of the image, she is walking on a sidewalk, holding her hair with one hand while looking directly at the camera.
